metadata.description: Azure region for all resources. Choose from Tier-1 list in docs/02-prerequisites.md § 11 (default recommendations: eastus2 / swedencentral / australiaeast / japaneast).
Workload name used in resource naming. Kept short to fit storage account 24-char limit.
Environment label (dev | test | prod). Used in resource naming and tagging.
OpenAI embedding model. Recommended: text-embedding-3-large. Acceptable cost-down: text-embedding-3-small.
OpenAI embedding model version. Leave blank to let Azure pick latest.
OpenAI embedding deployment TPM capacity in units of 1000 (e.g. 10 = 10K TPM).

OpenAI chat model. Default is EMPTY (no chat deployment is provisioned) because the locked design — Copilot Studio + AI Search hybrid index + integrated vectorizer — does NOT consume a chat completion model. Copilot Studio uses its own host model for generative answers. Set this to `gpt-4o` (or `gpt-4o-mini` for cost-down) only when an engagement explicitly needs a chat endpoint: custom app code calling completions, Foundry agent runtime, or a Copilot Studio bring-your-own-model configuration.
OpenAI chat model version. Leave blank to let Azure pick latest. Ignored when chatModelName is empty.
OpenAI chat deployment TPM capacity in units of 1000 (e.g. 10 = 10K TPM). Ignored when chatModelName is empty.

Set to true ONLY when redeploying after a `FlagMustBeSetForRestore` failure (Azure soft-delete recovery). When true, the Foundry account is restored in place from soft-delete, preserving the system-assigned MI principal ID and any role assignments granted to it. CAUTION: setting this to true on a fresh deploy (no soft-deleted account to restore) fails with `CanNotRestoreANonExistingResource`. Default false. See docs/06-troubleshooting.md § 0.5.
AI Search SKU. Standard (S1) or higher REQUIRED for semantic ranker — do not select Free or Basic.

Optional: object ID of the identity that will run the post-deploy script (scripts/post_deploy_search.py). When provided, the deployment grants Search Service Contributor + Search Index Data Contributor on the AI Search service so the script can authenticate with a bearer token. Find your own value with: az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv. Leave blank to assign these roles manually.
Principal type for deployerPrincipalId. Use User for an interactive az login identity (typical for first deploy), or ServicePrincipal for a CI/CD service principal or workload identity.

Set to true to also provision the OPTIONAL web-app hosting platform (Container Apps environment, Log Analytics, an Azure Container Registry, and a user-assigned managed identity) for the standalone chat front end in webapp/app. The container image is built and deployed afterwards by scripts/deploy-webapp.ps1. Default false — the base pattern (Copilot Studio path) does not need it; enable it for the Foundry-agent web-app front end (docs/09).
Tags applied to all resources for cost allocation + governance.
Key Vault name (3-24 chars, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens).
Azure region.
Resource tags.
Enable purge protection. Recommended ON for production; OFF for demo to allow clean teardown.
Soft-delete retention in days.
Storage account name (3-24 chars, lowercase alphanumeric only).
Azure region.
Resource tags.
Storage SKU. Standard_LRS for demo, Standard_GRS+ for production durability.
Names of blob containers to create.
Foundry resource name.
Azure region.
Resource tags.
Embedding model name (Azure OpenAI catalog).
Embedding model version. Leave blank to let Azure pick latest GA.
Embedding deployment TPM capacity in units of 1000.

Chat model name (Azure OpenAI catalog). Leave EMPTY to skip the chat deployment entirely — the default locked design (Copilot Studio + AI Search hybrid index + integrated vectorizer) does NOT consume a chat completion model, because Copilot Studio uses its own host model for generative answers. Only set this when you have an explicit engagement-specific need: custom app code calling completions, Foundry agent runtime, or a Copilot Studio bring-your-own-model configuration.
Chat model version. Leave blank to let Azure pick latest GA. Ignored when chatModelName is empty.
Chat deployment TPM capacity in units of 1000. Ignored when chatModelName is empty.

Set to true ONLY when an existing Foundry account with the same name is in Azure soft-delete state and you want Bicep to restore it in place (preserves the system-assigned MI principal ID and any role assignments granted to it). Default false. CAUTION: when this is true and there is no soft-deleted account to restore, the deploy fails with `CanNotRestoreANonExistingResource`. Set this to true only after a deploy fails with `FlagMustBeSetForRestore`. See docs/06-troubleshooting.md § 0.5.

resources.name: [parameters('name')]
resources.properties: [union(createObject('customSubDomainName', parameters('name'), 'publicNetworkAccess', 'Enabled', 'networkAcls', createObject('defaultAction', 'Allow'), 'disableLocalAuth', true()), if(parameters('restoreFromSoftDelete'), createObject('restore', true()), createObject()))]

metadata.description: AI Search service name (lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, must be globally unique).
Azure region.
Resource tags.
SKU. Standard (S1) MINIMUM for semantic ranker. Free/Basic are NOT supported by this pattern.
Replica count. 1 for demo, 2+ for production read availability.
Partition count. Scale up for index size beyond ~25 GB per partition.
Semantic ranker plan. "free" = 1000 queries/month included; "standard" = metered beyond free tier.
AI Search service system-assigned managed identity principal ID.
Foundry resource system-assigned managed identity principal ID. Granted Storage Blob Data Reader so Document Intelligence (served from the same Foundry account) can fetch raw/<file> via urlSource.
Storage account name (same RG as this deployment).
Foundry resource account name (same RG as this deployment).
AI Search service name (same RG as this deployment). Required for scoping deployer roles.
Key Vault name (same RG as this deployment). Required for scoping the deployer's Key Vault Secrets Officer role.

Optional: object ID of the user / service principal running the post-deploy script. When provided, grants Search Service Contributor + Search Index Data Contributor on the AI Search service so the script can authenticate with a bearer token instead of an admin key.
Principal type for deployerPrincipalId. Set to User for an interactive az login identity, or ServicePrincipal for a CI service principal / managed identity.
Azure Container Registry name (globally unique, alphanumeric, 5-50 chars).
Container Apps environment name.
Log Analytics workspace name backing the Container Apps environment.
User-assigned managed identity name for the web app runtime.
Azure region for all resources.
Tags applied to all resources.
Foundry resource account name (same RG). The app MI is granted data-plane roles here so it can invoke the agent.
